TWO REAL ROOT CAUSES FOUND on 1587a's first round — both were silently taxing EVERY codegen lane: (1) **MARKDOWN FENCE NEVER STRIPPED from code output.** The model wraps in ```javascript; unstripped, line 1 opens a template literal so the first ${...} explodes → CF PUT 10021 "Unexpected identifier '$'". Reproduced exactly: node --check on the committed file fails at the first ${ , passes once the fence is removed. The SPEC path stripped fences since day one; the CODE path never did. This is likely a share of the whole 10021/1101 history, incl. 1587's round-3 "" is not a function. (2) **deployStep always committed to the monorepo** regardless of the lane's binding — 2504's bb-gateway change landed in abilifi-apps, i.e. a lost change; same class as the fetchSpec repo bug. Both fixed + deployed (mastra ff7d4725): fence strip on codegen output, commits go to the bound repo (MAIN_REPO fallback). 2504 requeued — watching whether it now deploys clean.
